brief.headline: AEGIS Overwatch expanded to a living, destructible theater — multi-strike salvos, team ops, casualty model, SUNDOWN, reset. Sentinel hardening merged, main green. JARVIS HUD deployed.

items.text: AEGIS: added multi-strike salvos (up to 4 aim points, staggered, per-target BDA), a Pathfinder Team Ops panel (MOVE/HOLD/SWEEP/EXFIL with tap-to-move waypoints), a casualty model with distinct civilian vs. animal silhouettes, a destructible State Capitol, SUNDOWN full-theater leveling, and a RESET button.
AEGIS: sector intel is now live — structures standing, civ tracks, vehicles moving, herd size, tree line all count the real sim (341 -> 193 -> 0 verified across a salvo and SUNDOWN).
AEGIS: cinematic rewritten to showcase every system, and its STOP is now instant (previously took up to 11s, so the button looked dead).

AEGIS bugs fixed from an adversarial review + headless QA: recon scan-fx leak on redeploy, cinematic skipping its first strike when a weapon was pre-selected, tick-based log typewriter stalling on slow frames, top-bar overflow hiding RESET at laptop widths, arsenal clipping the 5th system when Team Ops opened.
Merged PR #4 — fixed the repo-wide CI Lint break (pinned lint job to Go 1.24 for golangci-lint v2.1.6); main's Lint/Build/Test are green again.
Merged PR #2 — hardened all 9 intrusive-tool output parsers against hostile input; caught and fixed a hashcat bug that fabricated 'hash recovered' findings from status banners.
Merged PR #3 — adversarial scope-matching tests for the authorization gate: wildcard/apex, path-prefix confusion, scheme strictness, deny-wins, kill-switch ordering, Chain fail-closed.
JARVIS personal command HUD built and deployed — voice loop, reactive orb, panels, agent roster, state pipeline (PR #1).
